summary: Comprehensive E2E test of 4 Bali Vision Tour changes: (1) footer admin link inline with copyright, (2) 15-min idle auto-logout with 1-min warning, (3) TipTap WYSIWYG for tours/cars/activities/articles + article paragraph blocks, (4) shared temple hero image on Activities/Tours/Articles/CarRental. All 4 features verified working via Playwright + backend API round-trip.
critical_code_review_comments:
RichTextEditor: onUpdate treats '

' as empty and returns ''. If user deliberately clears content on a legacy plain-text field this is fine; but combined with sanitizer in RichText.toHtml regex /<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i, any HTML-looking legacy string passes through without wrapping – acceptable.
IdleLogout: EVENTS include 'mousemove' with throttle 1s. If browser tab is inactive and setInterval throttles to 1s+, tick could exceed limit slightly but logout still fires correctly – acceptable.

Backend /api/content/{resource} accepts Dict[str, Any] with no schema for longDesc/longDescription; both legacy array and new HTML string coexist. Existing untouched items still render (verified for tours/activities/articles/cars public pages).
seed_data_creation: Modified seeded records for testing: cars/toyota-avanza-xenia longDesc appended ' TESTBOLD<ts>'; tours/family-picnic-in-bali longDescription appended ' TOURTAG' to last paragraph; articles/ultimate-first-timers-guide-east-nusa-penida-2025 gained one extra Paragraf block containing test text. Not restored; main agent may re-seed if needed (data is non-critical suffix text).
